name: print-social-april-fools-instagram-stories-purple-tap-to-claim-prank
title: Purple April Fools' story set with a 'TAP to claim your prize' fake-giveaway prank card
whatItIs: Five purple story cards with a party-horn icon: a giveaway card with a large 'TAP' circle button and 'Gotcha. No prize. But hey, you won our respect.' beneath, and four more cards pranking with a silent audio waveform, a fake 'new video', an unreadable QR-style pattern and a fake new-message notification, each tagged 'April Fool's Day'.
whatItMeans: Witty and interactive; mimicking real UI patterns (tap buttons, notifications) makes the prank feel like an actual app moment.
techniques: Mimic real app UI (buttons, notifications) for a convincing prank.
Reveal the joke's payoff only after the fake interaction.
Use one consistent badge label across all prank variations.

vocabulary.definition: A mimicked UI element used for comedic or marketing effect.
The punchline text revealed after an interaction.
